title: workspace.trace: which terms of the definitions a watch uses produced one summand of its value

workspace.description: The text of a .dcw file holding the watch and the definitions it uses.

word.description: The summand's word, as workspace.run gives it in 'summands'.

presentation.description: The text of a presentation file the context names, when it is not shipped.

scalars.description: Names to add to the context's scalars, as in workspace.run.

text.description: The summand with its coefficient in the watch's value.

sources.description: The contributions, which add up to the summand: each the product of some terms of the definitions (factors, with multiplicity) and what that product gives in the summand. A contribution with no factors comes from the watch's own terms.

term.description: The term's place among the definition's summands (as written), from 1.

power.description: How many times the product uses it.

text.description: The contribution: the summand's word with the part of its coefficient this product gives.
